mechanism: FDD with a first-order sliding mode observer estimating the joint torque fault (threshold tuned for detection within 0.1 s); estimated fault mapped to a kinematic deviation of the end effector and compensated by the kinematic controller exploiting redundancy; manipulator geometry chosen for an optimally fault-tolerant Jacobian
fault_info: detection;estimation (sliding-mode observer: residual threshold for detection and estimated torque fault; Sec. 2.3)
detection_delay: detection within 0.1 s by threshold tuning (bias faults, Sec. 5.1); fault estimate delayed by about 0.15 s by the low-pass filter (time-varying fault, Sec. 5.2)

mechanism: CNN-LSTM diagnosis of six fault classes from multi-sensor data triggers MPC-based fault-tolerant control with fault-specific compensation (feedforward gain and weight changes for wear, sensor-fusion position reconstruction for encoder drift, speed reduction for severe faults)
detection_delay: diagnosis below 50 ms; reconfiguration within 95 ms

mechanism: sensorless FDI: residual between motor torques of the real robot and a digital twin (threshold 0.3 Nm) isolates the broken cable; recovery strategy plans a motion in the residual static-equilibrium workspace (tension space, then linear path) to a safe pose with positive cable tensions
detection_delay: experiment 30-80 ms (along the cable), up to 200 ms (orthogonal motion), 190 ms in the recovery test; simulation 4 ms

mechanism: ML diagnosis (wavelet scattering + PCA + LDA features of the control signals, linear discriminant classifier) triggers reconfiguration of the scaling factors of an interval type-2 fuzzy PID controller, optimized by a genetic algorithm followed by gradient descent
detection_delay: diagnosis 68-93 ms; reconfiguration about 0.52 s, applied at the end of each 15 s cycle

mechanism: fault detection by residual threshold and fault/state estimation, followed by an adaptive backstepping controller with an adaptive mechanism compensating estimation errors under mismatched disturbances (asymptotic tracking)
